doom--noun.def: A terrible fate that cannot be avoided.

roar--verb.def: To make a deep loud sound.

queer--adj.def: Strange, in an older use of the word.
queer--adj.ex: He felt queer after the journey.

resignation--noun.def: The act of officially leaving a job.

blink--verb.def: To close and open your eyes quickly.
blink--verb.ex: He blinked in the bright light.

steer--verb.def: To control the direction of a vehicle.
steer--verb.ex: She steered the boat to shore.

injection--noun.def: The act of putting medicine into the body with a needle.

reform--noun.def: A change made to improve a system or a law.
reform--noun.ex: The reform took years to pass.

mother-in-law--noun.def: The mother of your husband or wife.
mother-in-law--noun.ex: My mother in law cooks beautifully.

formation--noun.def: The process of forming, or an arranged pattern.
formation--noun.ex: The formation of the cave took ages.

antique--adj.def: Old and valuable because of its age.

sponsor--verb.def: To pay for an event or a person's costs.

probe--noun.def: A thorough investigation, or a thin instrument.

underestimate--verb.def: To think something is smaller or easier than it is.

bomber--noun.def: A plane that drops bombs, or a person who plants one.

boiling--adj.def: At the temperature where a liquid turns to gas, or extremely hot.
boiling--adj.ex: Pour boiling water over the tea.

tramp--noun.def: A person with no home who travels from place to place.
tramp--noun.ex: A tramp slept under the bridge.

mentor--noun.def: An experienced person who advises someone younger.

arena--noun.def: A large building where sports or concerts take place.

hardware--noun.def: The physical parts of a computer, or metal tools.
hardware--noun.ex: The hardware is out of date.

irresponsible--adj.def: Not thinking about the results of what you do.

initiative--noun.def: A new plan to solve a problem, or the ability to act alone.

distraction--noun.ex: The phone is a constant distraction.

entertaining--adj.def: Amusing and enjoyable to watch or read.

banker--noun.def: A person with an important job in a bank.

temptation--noun.def: A strong wish to do something you should not do.

dove--noun.def: A white bird used as a symbol of peace.
dove--noun.ex: A dove landed on the roof.

sloppy--adj.ex: His work was sloppy this week.

comb--verb.def: To make hair tidy with a comb.

refuge--noun.ex: They took refuge in a cave.

specialty--noun.def: A subject you know best, or a food a place is famous for.

thirst--noun.def: The feeling of needing to drink.
thirst--noun.ex: Thirst drove them to the well.

select--verb.def: To choose carefully from a group.

knot--noun.def: A tight join made by tying rope or string.

massacre--noun.def: The killing of many people at once.

herb--noun.def: A plant used in cooking or in medicine.
herb--noun.ex: Add a fresh herb at the end.

nursery--noun.def: A place caring for small children, or growing young plants.

terrace--noun.def: A flat outdoor area beside a building.

trainer--noun.def: A person who trains people or animals.

father-in-law--noun.def: The father of your husband or wife.
father-in-law--noun.ex: My father in law owns a farm.

blossom--noun.def: The flowers on a fruit tree.

agony--noun.ex: He was in agony for hours.

mold--noun.def: A green growth on old food, or a shaped container.

fundamental--adj.def: Forming the base of something and very important.

potentially--adv.def: In a way that could happen in the future.

utter--verb.def: To say something, in formal or written English.
utter--verb.ex: He did not utter a word.

discharge--noun.def: The act of letting someone leave hospital or the army.
discharge--noun.ex: Her discharge is set for Friday.

substitute--verb.def: To use one thing in place of another.

splash--noun.def: The sound or mark made when something hits water.

exile--noun.def: Being forced to live away from your own country.
exile--noun.ex: He spent ten years in exile.

addiction--noun.def: The state of being unable to stop using something.

province--noun.def: One of the administrative areas of a country.

triangle--noun.def: A flat shape with three straight sides.
triangle--noun.ex: Draw a triangle on the board.

retrieve--verb.def: To get something back from where it was left.

extension--noun.def: Extra time given, or a new part built onto a house.
extension--noun.ex: They built an extension at the back.

hospitality--noun.def: Friendly and generous treatment of guests.
hospitality--noun.ex: We thanked them for their hospitality.

cozy--adj.ex: The kitchen is warm and cozy.

recommendation--noun.def: Advice that something is good or should be done.

microphone--noun.def: A device that makes a voice louder or records it.

toll--noun.def: Money paid to use a road, or the number harmed by a disaster.

reconsider--verb.def: To think about a decision again.

overboard--adv.def: Over the side of a ship into the water.

facilities--noun.def: Buildings and equipment provided for a purpose.
facilities--noun.ex: The school has good sports facilities.

donation--noun.def: Money or goods given to help others.

boxer--noun.def: A person who fights in the sport of boxing.

misfortune--noun.def: Bad luck, or an unlucky event.

maestro--noun.def: A great musician, especially a conductor.

involvement--noun.def: The fact of taking part in something.

wilderness--noun.def: A large wild area where nobody lives.
wilderness--noun.ex: They crossed the wilderness on foot.

sage--noun.def: A herb with grey leaves, or a very wise person.
